description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named DoneButtonActivity that demonstrates customizing the action bar with a custom 'Done' button and handling menu options like 'Cancel'.

classes.name: DoneButtonActivity
classes.description: An Activity demonstrating a custom action bar with a 'Done' button and cancel menu handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the Activity, inflates a custom action bar view, sets up the 'Done' button click listener, and sets the activity's content view.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu, including the cancel menu item.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically the 'cancel' action which finishes the activity.
